title: Tenant region fidelity guard and automated evidence builder
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Introduce a region-fidelity guard for hosted endpoints that allows tenants to declare preferred/required location commitments, preview enforcement with a dry-run mode, and produce a compressed, legal-ready evidence bundle for audits. The feature focuses on deterministic routing rules, conflict detection/resolution, retention lifecycle metadata, and an exportable evidence format that ties routing decisions to audit trails.
notes: 2026-02-10 - Initial ticket created. Goal: provide operators and customers a defendable way to assert and prove where tenant data was processed by the hosted API. Scope includes UI flows, policy DSL, enforcement mode (soft/strict), dry-run validation, and an evidence export format consumable by legal/compliance teams.

2026-02-17 - PM sync: decided that enforcement will support two modes: 'affinity' (soft) and 'fidelity' (strict). Affinity will bias routing but allow fallbacks with rationale recorded; fidelity will block non-compliant routing and surface immediate errors to callers. Both modes will produce audit events.

2026-02-22 - Eng feedback (Kunal): runtime must stamp requests with chosen-region and fallback-reason headers; requires a minor V2 change to routing service. ENG to prototype header contract in ENG-23456. Added dependency to ENG-23456.

2026-03-01 - Design review: console mockups reviewed. UX will expose a wizard to declare endpoint locale intent, a conflict preview that runs dry-run across historical traffic (7-day sample), and a downloadable evidence bundle button. Design feedback: show estimated request impact and P50/P95 reroute latency when falling back.

2026-03-05 - Legal/Compliance review: evidence bundle must include: policy manifest, time-windowed routing log (hashed identifiers), retention TTL metadata per-route, KMS-wrapped envelope, and human-readable summary. Agreed format: residency-evidence.v1.zip containing manifest.json, logs.ndjson, summary.pdf, and signatures.txt.

2026-03-08 - Implementation plan: split into three deliverables: (A) policy DSL + API surface for endpoint declarations, (B) Console wizard + dry-run preview, (C) Evidence builder & export pipeline. Canary rollout planned for a subset of new tenants.

2026-03-10 - Updated acceptance criteria and QA checklist. Security review required before launch. Added release target hosted-api-2026.03 for the policy API and hosted-api-2026.04 for the Console UX + evidence export.

Open questions: how to surface rejection semantics to SDKs (HTTP 409 vs 422), retention of routing logs for evidence generation (default 90 days vs configurable), and quota interactions when a request is rerouted to a different region tier. Action: PM to define defaults and raise to pricing team if cross-region egress costs are affected.
